datasheet_identity.title: DSK12 THRU DSK120 - SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: The forward-voltage table row is a maximum value for the DSK115-DSK120 group at IF = 1 A; the plotted curve is a typical DSK110-DSK115 family characteristic.
IR1 is 0.05 mA at the rated 150 V DC blocking voltage and Ta = 25 degC; the separate 5 mA Ta = 100 degC row was not used.
Schottky barrier rectifier; no reverse-recovery time is published in the supplied datasheet.
The Fig. 3 curve was digitized from the supplied vector plot path without interpolation between table values.
